name: Ovelha Trax 5th Anniversary (Free Entry)
description: Ovelha Trax celebrates its 5th anniversary with a free entry event at Gare Porto. The lineup includes Catarina Silva, System Sophie b2b Banditst4r, and Mingote b2b Ricki.
longDescription:
Ovelha Trax marks its 5th anniversary with a special event at Gare Porto. The night features a lineup of DJs, including Catarina Silva, System Sophie b2b Banditst4r, and Mingote b2b Ricki.

The event takes place on Friday, November 27, 2026, starting at 11:00 PM and running until 6:00 AM. Entry is free for all attendees.

Gare Porto is located at Rua da Madeira 182, 4000-330 Porto. The music styles for the night include Breakbeat, Electro, Ghettotech, Techno, and Acid Techno.
